title: Ae mere bhai reza
body:
Ae mere bhai reza
Ae mere Bhai RAZA-2
<<DIVIDER>>
Assalamo alaika ya ghareebal ghuraba ya moinaz zoafaye wal fuqara
As sultan Arab E wal ajam
Mola ALI ibna MUSA RAZA.
<<MINI>>
Ay mere Bhai RAZA-3
<<DIVIDER>>
AY GHAREEBUL GHURABA AY MERE BHAI RAZA-2
Roke MAASOOMA E QUM-2 qum SE deti hain sada
<<MINI>>
Ay mere Bhai RAZA
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Tera deedar nahi Bhai qismat me meri, De hawaon ko Zara hukm ay mere ALI
Sun lun awaaz teri-2 dil behel jaye mera
<<MINI>>
Ay mere Bhai RAZA..
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay GHA
2) Dekhne aayi hun mai qum me Surat teri, Ay ghareebul ghuraba dekh ghurbat meri, Koyi batlata nahi-2 mujhko mashhad ka pata.
<<MINI>>
Ay mere Bhai RAZA.
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Mujhpe Jo beet gaye wo alam kuch bhi nahi, Samne ZAINAB k mere gham kuch bhi nahi, Maina bazaaar gayi-2 na chini meri rida.
4) Jabse pahonchi hun mai qum dil hai qabu me kahan, Gham zada aaye nazar shehr k peer O jawan, Dekh kar kaale alam-2 dil dehelta hai mera.
Ay mere..
Ay ghareebul
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Hun yateema lekin wo yateema to nahi, Qaidi Baba KI qasam mai SAKINA to nahi, Jiske gohar bhi chine-2 haye jiska daaman bhi jala.
Ay
GHAREEBUL ghuraba
6) Kis jagah kaante chubhe kis jagah thak k giri, Poocho chalo se Zara kaise Milo mai chali, Zakhm pairo k tumhe-2 gham sunayenge mera.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay..
Ay ghareebul..
7) Sath jayega mere ye gham e tanhayi, Tum bhi AKBAR KI tarha nahi laute Bhai, Roz SUGHRA ki tarha mai jalati hun diya.
8) Qum SE mashad Jo gaya zair e MOLA RAZA, Ay takallum wo yahi leke paigham chala, Rasta Teri behen-2 ab takti hai tera.
<<MINI>>
Ay mere Bhai RAZA
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay ghareebal ghuraba.
